scope.summary: Implement region-mask write enforcement per Section 13.17 (BK-17.1, TAI-BK-029/030), closing REQ-001/REQ-002 — the decoupling law made mechanical: a channel MUST NOT write outside its declared region mask, proven zero-tolerance by the BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID validator: every sparse delta index in every morph asset resolves inside the channel's mask, and evaluating any single channel across its full designed range on the neutral body produces zero displacement outside the mask.
acceptance_criteria: Import-time check: registering a morph asset whose SparseDeltas contain any vertex_id outside the owning channel's mask fails with a typed finding listing the offending vertex ids (zero tolerance, not epsilon).

Evaluation-time check: sweep_channel(channel_key, samples across [min, design_max]) on the neutral body asserts zero displacement (exact 0.0 mm) on every vertex outside the mask, for every sampled value.

The composite registers as ValidationDescriptor BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID (Blocking) consumable by the 13.15 runner; the descriptor accepts an archetype-matrix mode (body list parameter) for the MT-641 matrix run.
A deliberately-poisoned fixture channel (one out-of-mask delta) fails both the import check and the sweep check in tests.
Dialing the fixture breast channel moves zero shoulder/hip vertices — an explicit named regression test for the OBR-002/003 founding requirement.
scope.risk_if_missed: This validator IS the anti-ERC guarantee; without mechanical zero-tolerance proof, hidden cross-region writes creep in asset by asset until breast dials drag shoulders and hips again — the exact Daz failure the operator founded BodyKit to remove.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
